_comment: Per-stack parameter values for dev; convert to --parameter-overrides per template. Not deployed.
_oidc_note: OidcProviderArn existence is UNVERIFIED. One provider per account; it is created outside per-env stacks, only after explicit approval (see docs/runbooks/first-deploy.md).
_code_keys_note: Lambda S3 keys are supplied by the pipeline at deploy time as <commit-sha>/<function>.zip; never hard-coded here.
_origin_verify_note: 40-web OriginVerifySecret is NOT stored here: the pipeline reads SSM SecureString /sentinelqa/dev/edge/origin-verify and passes it as a NoEcho override (ADR-0015).

_meta._note: Not template parameters. 'all' keys go only to stacks that declare them (EnvProfile: 20-data, 30-api, 50-observability).
